name: afi-mcp
description: The first CLI for Afi SaaS backup — full public-API coverage plus the fleet-wide coverage, staleness, and offboarding answers the rate-limited API can't serve live.

afi_api_key.title: AFI_API_KEY
afi_api_key.description: Sets AFI_API_KEY for the Afi MCP server.

afi_base_url.title: Afi API base URL
afi_base_url.description: Base URL for the Afi API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

afi_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
afi_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write to Afi: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

afi_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
afi_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

afi_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
afi_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Afi requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

afi_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
afi_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
